mapper.select: SELECT p.perm_code FROM t_admin_role_permission rp JOIN t_admin_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.sort_no, p.id
SELECT permission_id FROM t_admin_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id
SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id FROM t_admin_role_permission rp JOIN t_admin_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.perm_code = #{permCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_admin_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
